rows.note: Use 功課 for a school assignment, homework, or coursework.

example.english: The teacher gave me an assignment.
example.traditional: 老師派咗一份功課畀我。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 paai3 zo2 jat1 fan6 gung1 fo3 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use 任務 as the all-purpose term for an assigned task outside school.

example.english: We need to complete this assignment today.
example.traditional: 呢個任務要喺今日完成。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jam6 mou6 jiu3 hai2 gam1 jat6 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use 分工 when the assignment means dividing responsibilities among people or groups.

example.english: The assignment of responsibilities for this event is very clear.
example.traditional: 今次活動嘅分工好清楚。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 ge3 fan1 gung1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use 職位 when an assignment means an official post or position someone is sent to fill.

example.english: Their overseas assignment is a very important position.
example.traditional: 佢今次外派嘅職位幾重要。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 ngoi6 paai3 ge3 zik1 wai6 gei2 zung6 jiu3
